iWantTo: open a SKU detail view showing that SKU's stock across all its locations including its tracking code
soThat: I can inspect one SKU in depth, not just scan the whole-warehouse overview

independence.rationale: S2's home table shows SKU/location/quantity aggregated across the warehouse but not per-SKU drill-down, tracking codes, or optional detail. S3 adds a single-SKU view scoped to one SKU across its locations, surfaces the combined inventory_code, and renders a 'not tracked' state for untracked optional detail (par level). Building S1 and S2 fully leaves no per-SKU detail screen, so S3 is genuinely unbuilt.
